attributes.title: 2027 Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs. The chapter page gives the dates as February 5 and 6, while ACP's national meeting calendar lists the event through Sunday, February 7, so confirm the final day before booking.

The meeting brings chapter members together for clinical updates in internal medicine. Credit totals, fees and room rates had not been posted when we checked. Registration should appear on the chapter page as the date gets closer.
